'''Phileas''' was a mini [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] that was sold on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was so small that it could be carried around by a person.

==Behind the scenes==
Phileas is a [[:w:c:cwa:Companion|companion]] for players in the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]. It can be bought for 450 [[:w:c:cwa:Station Cash|Station Cash]] from the [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] [[80-T5]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].
